title: Mobile Wallet Wrong-Wallet Errors: When the Misdirection Period Starts
content:
Disputes team counting convention for **Mobile Wallet** wrong-wallet errors: the date from which the days the money was misdirected are counted.

**Convention.** The starting date is set by the transfer's promise and the customer's notice:

1. on a tier whose minute promise is above 0, from the date part of the transfer's release moment;
2. on any other tier, when the notice came within 2 calendar days of the date available, from the date available;
3. otherwise, from the notice date.

Minute promise by tier, which decides line 1:

| Tier | Minute promise after release |
|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 10 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 0 |

## Input, judgement, starting date (hypothetical transfers, date available 2026-04-10)

| Tier | Released | Notice date | Starting date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 2026-04-10 at 09:15 | 2026-04-25 | 2026-04-10, the release date |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 2026-04-10 at 09:15 | 2026-04-12 (2 days after) | 2026-04-10, the date available |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 2026-04-10 at 09:15 | 2026-04-13 (3 days after) | 2026-04-13, the notice date |
